## Validation

- [ ] `./mvnw -B verify`
- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run type-check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, generated data, or local environment files
- [ ] Manager and generated-API authentication boundaries remain separate
- [ ] API contract or configuration changes are documented
